description: Sayadieh Fish Rice is a beloved Middle Eastern seafood dish featuring perfectly cooked fish, aromatic spiced rice, and sweet caramelized onions. This flavorful recipe offers a comforting and satisfying meal, often served for special occasions or family gatherings. Its unique blend of spices and textures makes it a true culinary delight.

instructions.title: Prepare and Fry the Fish
instructions.text: Pat the fish fillets dry and season generously with salt, pepper, and a pinch of Sayadieh spice mix. Heat a few tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the fish fillets for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Remove fish from the skillet and set aside on a plate.

instructions.title: Caramelize the Onions
instructions.text: In the same skillet, add the remaining 1/2 cup of olive oil. Add the thinly sliced onions and cook over medium-low heat for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply caramelized and dark brown. This step is crucial for the color and flavor of the rice. Remove about half of the caramelized onions and set aside for garnish.

instructions.title: Prepare the Spice Paste
instructions.text: To the remaining caramelized onions in the skillet, add the Sayadieh spice mix (or individual spices: 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tsp allspice, 1 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp black pepper). Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until fragrant. This toasts the spices and enhances their flavor.

instructions.title: Cook the Rice
instructions.text: Add the soaked and drained basmati rice to the skillet with the spiced onions. Stir gently to coat the rice grains. Pour in the warm fish stock or water, then add salt and pepper to taste. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 15-18 minutes, or until all the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.

instructions.title: Rest and Fluff the Rice
instructions.text: Once the rice is cooked, remove it from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5-10 minutes. This allows the steam to redistribute and makes the rice fluffier. After resting, gently fluff the rice with a fork.

instructions.title: Assemble and Serve
instructions.text: Transfer the spiced rice to a large serving platter. Arrange the fried fish fillets on top of the rice. Garnish generously with the reserved caramelized onions, toasted pine nuts, and fresh chopped parsley. Serve immediately with lemon wedges on the side for squeezing over the fish.

tips: Achieve truly dark caramelized onions by cooking them slowly over low heat for a longer duration. This is key for the rice's distinctive color and depth of flavor.
For an authentic Sayadieh spice blend, combine ground cumin, allspice, turmeric, cinnamon, and a pinch of cardamom. Adjust quantities to your preference.
Always serve Sayadieh with fresh lemon wedges. The acidity of the lemon brightens the rich flavors of the dish and complements the fish beautifully.
